title: Feasibility Study of a Percutaneous Mitral Valve Repair System.
brief_summary: Prospective, multi-center, Phase I study of the Evalve Cardiovascular Valve Repair System (CVRS) in the treatment of mitral valve regurgitation. Patients will undergo 30-day, 6 month, 12 month, and 5 year clinical follow-up.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Have moderate to severe mitral regurgitation, symptomatic or asymptomatic with evidence of left ventricular dysfunction;
* Experience regurgitation origination from the central two-thirds of the valve;
* Qualify as a candidate for mitral valve surgery including cardiopulmonary bypass.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Ejection fraction \< 30%
* Endocarditis
* Rheumatic heart disease
* Renal insufficiency
